decision.reason: The exact contract is rejected by the exact capture after the runner consumes the one-shot attempt, and the compute-app query still masks command failure as an empty process list.

P0.title: The exact repaired contract cannot pass the exact capture validator and burns the one-shot attempt before failing
evidence: The contract milestone is M714-r2-repair-after-M720, while validate_m714_contract requires exactly M714-r2.
The contract identity has six keys including m720_failed_static_review, while the capture requires exactly five keys and rejects that extra member.
The runner verifies only contract/capture SHA before four idle samples, then creates ATTEMPT, and only afterwards launches the capture that performs these semantic checks.
P0.risk: A nominal launch consumes the only attempt, immediately fails before M366/CUDA, and quarantines a non-result. The authorized capture can never be produced by this exact tuple.
P0.required_fix: Make the contract milestone and identity key set exactly match the capture validator (or deliberately revise the validator), refresh all dependent SHAs, and repeat a fresh static hammer.

P0.title: The compute-app idle query is fail-open on nvidia-smi failure
P0.evidence: GPU_APPS uses nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps ... || true inside command substitution. A command error therefore becomes an empty string, which satisfies the later -z GPU_APPS idle predicate.
P0.risk: If compute-app enumeration fails while the utilization/memory sample remains parseable and below threshold, an existing GPU process can be treated as absent; process-name scanning does not cover arbitrary compute applications.
P0.required_fix: Capture and require a zero exit status for compute-app enumeration before evaluating its output; do not convert query failure into the same value as an empty process set. Refresh runner SHA and rehammer.

P2.title: The capture module docstring still calls an optimistic lower bound a conservative issue schedule
P2.evidence: The opening docstring says conservative issue schedule, while the contract, output fields, and claim boundary correctly state that address formation, deduplication, macro response, selection, broadcast, accumulator update, output control and backpressure are uncharged ideal-resource lower bounds.
P2.risk: A source-level description can be quoted out of context and overstate the meaning of future pattern results.
P2.required_fix: Rename the docstring phrase to ideal-resource issue lower bound; retain executable_cycle=false and the existing terminal claim boundary.

claim_boundary: This FAIL review authorizes no runner execution, remote/GPU capture, attempt/result creation, M714 pattern result, executable cycle, real-output miter, RTL/VCS, Synopsys PPA/energy, accuracy, system speedup, or paper headline. Only source identities, requested process-regex behavior, static accounting structure, and the two blocking defects are admitted.
